cultura.name: La Cueca
cultura.description:
Chile's national dance — a flirtatious courtship between man and woman with a handkerchief.
Danced everywhere during Fiestas Patrias in September, from city squares to rural farms.

cultura.name: La Cultura Rapa Nui
cultura.description:
Polynesian people carved 900 moai statues from volcanic rock over 500 years.
Their oral traditions, dance, and tattooing culture survive in the Tapati festival today.

cultura.name: La Cultura Mapuche
cultura.description:
The Mapuche people resisted both Inca and Spanish conquest for centuries.
Their weaving, ceremonial music (kultrún drum), and cosmology remain alive today.

cultura.name: La Nueva Canción Chilena
cultura.description:
Political folk music movement of the 1960s–70s — Víctor Jara and Violeta Parra.
Used Andean instruments to carry messages of social justice to the world.

india_traveller.visa_note: Indian passport holders require a tourist visa for Chile, applied for at the Chilean Consulate in Delhi or Mumbai. The process takes approximately 2–4 weeks and requires proof of accommodation and return ticket. Chile is a modern, well-organised country, and the consular process is straightforward.
india_traveller.flight_note: No direct flights from India to Chile. Common routes fly via Dubai (Emirates to Santiago), Doha (Qatar Airways), Madrid (Iberia + LATAM), or São Paulo (LATAM). Total journey time is typically 22–28 hours. Santiago's Arturo Merino Benítez (SCL) is the main international hub.
india_traveller.cost_per_day_inr: Chile is one of the more expensive South American countries. Budget travellers need around ₹4,500–7,000/day. Mid-range travel costs ₹9,000–15,000/day. Patagonia is premium — budget ₹15,000–20,000/day for Torres del Paine. Santiago has good value set-lunch menus (almuerzo) for ₹600–900.
india_traveller.veg_tips: Chile has limited vegetarian options outside Santiago. In the capital, look for vegetarian restaurants in Barrio Italia and Barrio Lastarria. Humitas (corn paste), pebre (salsa), and salads are safe. Empanadas de queso (cheese) are widely available. Phrase to use: 'Soy vegetariano/a, sin carne ni mariscos, por favor.'
